title: Stabilized thioamide peptide agonists of the neuropeptide Y type 2 receptor for targeted cancer imaging
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CB00042H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hoang Anh T. Phan, Yanan Chang, Taylor M. Barrett, Kristen E. Fiore, Daniel Y. Zhang, Ethan J. Grove, E. James Petersson
A fluorescent cyclic thioamide peptide has a serum half life over 8 hours and high selectivity for binding to Y2R receptor expressing cells, enabling imaging of neuroblastomas and glioblastomas.
